640:t_1:86.en:
$$赤木$$
「So Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, Dr. $$トライア$$ and the rest... Scientists from all over the world pitched in, figured out that technology, and perfected it as a power to save humanity. Is that how it went?」

640:t_1:87.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's truly the crystallization of humanity's wisdom.」

640:t_1:88.en:
$$万丈$$
「Even if we're up against a great collapse that comes once every 120 million years, if every human on Earth combines their strength, we're sure to get through it.」

640:t_1:90.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What's wrong, $$シルヴィア$$? Did the number get so big it made your head spin?」

640:t_1:91.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「It's not that, I just... find it strange...」

640:t_1:93.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「The unit of a 'year' is based on the time it takes the Earth to go around the sun once, right?」

640:t_1:94.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「So why is it used to describe something on the scale of the whole universe?」

640:t_1:95.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Now that you mention it, you're right.」

640:t_1:96.en:
$$桂$$
「Now that's what you call the mystery of the universe.」

640:t_1:97.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Do you get it, $$シビル$$?」

640:t_1:100.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If we ever meet again, maybe I'll ask that $$ゲペルニッチ$$ jerk.」

640:t_1:102.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You seem to be feeling something like a premonition.」

640:t_1:105.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Contact with $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, the ruins on $$神根島$$... And then the fundamental calamity...」

640:t_1:106.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And always lurking behind it all is God... the existence of a higher-dimensional life form...」

640:t_1:107.en:
$$キリコ$$
「In this battle, I'm sure we'll touch that truth.」

640:t_1:108.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I wonder what it will bring to humanity as it welcomes a new era...」

640:t_1:112.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, Onboard Facilities ～

640:t_1:115.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Um... Everyone in Class 3-4 at $$陣代高校$$, how are you? This is $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

640:t_1:117.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We've caused you all a lot of trouble and worry, but we're managing somehow.」

640:t_1:118.en:
$$宗介$$
「I made a promise to bring $$千鳥$$ home, and I will definitely keep it once this war is over. Please wait until then.」

640:t_1:119.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Me, $$宗介$$ and all the Volunteer Club members want to graduate from $$陣代高校$$ together with everyone from Class 2-4. So we'll definitely be back by March!」

640:t_1:120.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know Earth is in trouble too, but I'm heading out.」

640:t_1:123.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Still a bit stiff in the face, I'd say...」

640:t_1:124.en:
$$クラン$$
「Especially $$宗介$$! How many times do I have to tell you before you can manage a smile!」

640:t_1:125.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am not an actor. I cannot smile just because I am told to.」

640:t_1:126.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I'd known it would turn into such a hassle, I should have forced myself to show my face at $$陣代高校$$...」

640:t_1:127.en:
$$宗介$$
「That may be true, $$千鳥$$... But this past month every one of us has been busy in our own way. We had no time for that.」

640:t_1:128.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Especially $n, who's been working with the Reactor group on Dr. $$トライア$$'s team's research the whole time.」

640:t_1:129.en:
$n
「That's why sending a video letter instead was a good idea, but I never thought we'd struggle this much...」

640:t_1:130.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... This is such a hassle, so why don't you just put on a $$ボン太くん#robot$$ suit?」

640:t_1:131.en:
$$宗介$$
「Good idea. Then Captain $$クラン$$ will be satisfied, too.」

640:t_1:132.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, you! You brought that thing aboard!?」

640:t_1:133.en:
$$宗介$$
「I judged that it would be ample combat strength in the battles ahead as well.」

640:t_1:134.en:
$n
「So that's why Lieutenant $$サックス$$ and $$アル$$ were arguing in the hangar yesterday...」

640:t_1:135.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The 'catch the enemy off guard' tactic $$アル$$ talks about... I doubt how effective it really is.」

640:t_1:136.en:
$$宗介$$
「With all due respect, Miss $$スズネ$$. I have spent most of this past month on its refit.」

640:t_1:137.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sadly only one prototype was completed, but perfecting coordinated attacks on a target by unmanned escorts, based on $$ルカ$$'s RVF-25, is...」

640:t_1:138.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you'd cut out that pointless effort, you'd have had plenty of time to go to $$陣代高校$$...!」

640:t_1:139.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$千鳥$$! We seek lasting peace through mutual understanding...」

640:t_1:140.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't think you and I will ever understand each other!」

640:t_1:141.en:
$$クラン$$
「OK! We got a good shot!」

640:t_1:143.en:
$$クラン$$
「Yes, yes! As I thought, you two are better when you're natural!」

640:t_1:144.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So what was all our hard work up to Take 27 for...?」

640:t_1:147.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$! You haven't forgotten your promise to treat me to Galaxy Ramen, have you!」

640:t_1:148.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$風間$$! I got my hands on the first issue of 'Monthly Men's Super Robot' you wanted, so look forward to it!」

640:t_1:149.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$恭子$$, $$詩織$$! Are you working hard on your exam prep!?」

640:t_1:150.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll show my face at the graduation ceremony, too! Let's all go to karaoke again!」

640:t_1:152.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But please spare me being treated like a handyman the second I show my face!」

640:t_1:153.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We do activities other than picking up trash, you know.」

640:t_1:154.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$大貫$$, sorry for letting you down. When I get back, hire me again!」

640:t_1:155.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hello everyone, how are you? This is former student teacher $$西条涼音$$.」

640:t_1:156.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n and I are doing well, too! I... The two of us, $n and I, are looking forward to the day we can see you all!」

640:t_1:157.en:
$n
「H-hey, Miss $$スズネ$$! You're overdoing the appeal!」

640:t_1:158.en:
$$ボス$$
「Ha ha ha! Too bad, boys - me included!」

640:t_1:159.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「These two... seem to have become a couple before we knew it!」

640:t_1:163.en:
$n
「Wha! What are you saying, Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

640:t_1:164.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The cool, wild, brooding $n that everyone knows is dead!」

640:t_1:165.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's here now is a dimwit who can't even read the room but got himself a girlfriend!」

640:t_1:168.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「The power to love is infinite, after all.」

640:t_1:148: 'Monthly Men's Super Robot' is my rendering of 『月刊・男のスーパーロボット』.
640:t_1:143: お前達 read as 'you two' (Kaname and Sousuke being filmed).
640:t_1:105: ワイズマン uses the #pilot token (the being).
